title: Comment-Extractor Codebase Analysis
summary:
This is a web scraping application using Playwright to extract posts and comments 
from social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, and potentially others).

The architecture follows several design patterns:
- Registry Pattern for scrapers and exporters
- Template Method Pattern for base scraper
- Page Object Model for Instagram scraper
- Service Layer for orchestration
- Adapter Pattern for storage backends

Main entry point is extract.py with dual CLI implementations (extract.py and src/cli/main.py).
